member.name: T:MelloSilveiraTools.DependencyInjection
member.summary: Provides extension methods to dependency injection of Tools project (meta-package).
Registers the services of every contextual MelloSilveiraTools package (Core, Database, WebApi, Plugins, Mathematics, MechanicsOfMaterials, and Optimizations). All configuration settings are optional.
member.param: Service collection that receives the registrations.
Optional settings that parameterize the resilience pipelines.
Optional database connection and behavior settings.
Optional settings used by the encryption service.
Optional settings that describe plugin folders and behavior.
Optional settings used to send e-mails through an SMTP server.
Optional settings used to configure root directories and storage policies.
Optional settings used by logger service.
Optional curve fitter configuration options controlling deterministic seeding and default fitter engine.
Optional settings used by experimental data processing and optimization pipelines.
Optional settings used by parametric sweep sensitivity analysis pipelines.
Optional configuration settings for real-time progress notifications.
Indicates whether to register mechanical model calculators. Defaults to true.
member.returns: The same instance to allow call chaining.
